# Parker Gawryletz — Ceremony Pianist & Sound Director

Parker Gawryletz is a Cochrane, Alberta-based wedding ceremony pianist, private-event
pianist, and piano mentor, operating as Gawryletz Music. The wedding offering — branded
"Assured Ceremony Audio™" — pairs live ceremony piano with officiant/vow microphones,
silent battery power, SPL-aware mixing, triple-redundant gear, and a written audio plan
delivered within 24 hours. Parker serves the full southern Alberta and Bow Valley region:
Calgary, Cochrane, Canmore, Banff, Airdrie, Okotoks, Bragg Creek, Priddis, Lake Louise,
and Kananaskis — including Parks Canada acoustic-only ceremonies at Banff and Lake Louise.
Three lines of work: weddings, private events, and one-to-one piano mentorship.

## Services & Pricing (CAD)
- The Vow — Ceremony Only ($650): the ceremony itself, 30–45 minutes of devoted presence
- The Hour — Ceremony + Prelude/Cocktails ($750): guest arrival through the ceremony into cocktails (most chosen)
- The Story — Full Day ($1,200): full-day musical witness, first guest to last glass raised
- Private Events: bespoke live piano, custom setlists, the pianist comes to you
- Piano Mentorship: one-to-one lessons at $60/hr, no deadlines or grades, real repertoire from the first week

## Every Booking Includes (weddings)
Full 88-key piano, vow/officiant clarity audio system, triple redundancy (backup instrument,
power, and audio), 60-minute early arrival and sound check, $4M liability insurance, and a
collaborative cue sheet co-authored with your planner and officiant.
